text: Talk to Brundt in Rellekka's longhall.
dialogue: I want to become a Fremennik!

text: Talk to Olaf the Bard north east of the longhall.
Talk to Lalli to the south east of Rellekka.
Return to Rellekka and talk to Askeladden for a pet rock.
Return to Lalli and use a onion, cabbage, potato, and pet rock on their stew. You can find the vegetables growing in the south east of Rellekka.
Talk to Lalli for golden wool.
Go south east of Rellekka and cut a branch from the swaying tree
Use a knife on the branch to make an unstrung lyre
Spin the golden fleece into wool using a spinning wheel. The closest wheel is in Seers' Village.
Use the golden wool on your unstrung lyre.
Bring your lyre to the Strange Altar south west of Rellekka, and use either a raw shark, raw sea turtle or raw manta ray on it.
Return to Rellekka and enter the longhall's stage to perform. Once on stage, play the enchanted lyre.
Use a cabbage on the stew.
Use a potato on the stew.
Use your pet rock on the stew.
Talk to Manni the Reveller in the Rellekka longhall.
Get some beer. There is beer tankard in the Rellekka longhall.
Give the Council workman on the bridge south of Rellekka going to Seer's Village a beer.
Buy some alcohol free beer from the Poison Salesman in the Seer's Village pub.
Return to Rellekka with the strange object, a tinderbox, and low alcohol beer.
Use a tinderbox on the strange object then use it on the nearby pipe.
Pick up a keg of beer in the longhall.
Use the low alcohol beer on the keg of beer whilst in the longhall.
Talk to Manni the Reveller to cheat in the competition.
Use the lit strange object on the nearby pipe!
Talk to Sigli south of the longhall for a hunters' talisman.
Use the hunter's talisman to hunt down the Draugen. It'll appear near one of the butterflies in the area.
Return the charged hunters' talisman to Sigli.
Talk to Sigmund the Merchant in the Rellekka market.
Talk to the Sailor on the docks.
Talk to Olaf the Bard east of the longhall.
Talk to Ysra in her shop west of the market.
Talk to Brundt in the longhall.
Talk to Sigli south of the longhall.
Talk to Skulgrimen north of the longhall.
Talk to the Fisherman on the pier north of the market.
Talk to Swensen the Navigator in his hut south west of the longhall.
Talk to Peer the Seer south west of the market.
Talk to Thorvald north of the longhall.
Talk to Manni the Reveller in the longhall.
Talk to Thora the Barkeep in the longhall.
Talk to Askeladden south of the longhall.
Bring the promissory note to Thora the Barkeep in the longhall.
Bring the cocktail to Manni the Reveller in the longhall.
Bring the champions token to Thorvald north of the longhall.
Bring the warriors' contract to Peer the Seer south west of the market.
Bring the weather forecast to Swensen the Navigator in his hut south west of the longhall.
Bring the sea fishing map to the Fisherman on the pier north of the market.
Bring the unusual fish to Skulgrimen north of the longhall.
Bring the custom bow string to Sigli south of the longhall.
Bring the tracking map to Brundt in the longhall.
Bring the fiscal statement to Ysra in her shop west of the market.
Bring the sturdy boots to Olaf the Bard east of the longhall.
Bring the ballad to the Sailor on the docks.
Finally, bring the exotic flower to Sigmund the Merchant in the Rellekka market.
Talk to Askeladden south of the longhall.
Talk to Thorvald north of the longhall.
When you're ready to fight Koschei, go down the ladder.
Fight Koschei the Deathless and 'kill' him at least 3 times. Dying to his fourth phase is a SAFE death.
Fight Koschei the Deathless and 'kill' him at least 3 times. Dying to his fourth phase is a SAFE death.
Fight Koschei the Deathless and 'kill' him at least 3 times. Dying to his fourth phase is a SAFE death.
You must now either die (SAFE DEATH), or defeat Koschei once more. Do not leave or you'll have to fight him again.
Talk to Swensen the Navigator in his hut south west of the longhall.
Talk to Peer the Seer south west of the Rellekka market. You will need to bank all your items. Peer will offer to do this for you.
Try to enter Peer the Seer's house after banking all your items. Peer the Seer will offer to bank everything for you.
Enter the solution to Peer's door.
Click on the door again, then click the highlighted arrows to solve the combination lock with solution MIND.

text: Search the bookcase for a red herring. If you've already unlocked the mural, go search it instead.
Use the red herring on the cooking range.
Use the sticky red goop on the wooden disk.
Open and go down the trapdoor.
Use the old red disk on the abstract mural.
Use the other red disk on the abstract mural.
Use the red disks on the abstract mural.
Search the cupboard in the south west of the room.
Search the cupboard in the south west of the room.
Search the chest in the south of the room.
Search the chest in the south of the room.
Use the empty bucket on the tap.
Use the full bucket on the empty jug.
Empty the full jug into the drain.
Use the 2/5ths full bucket on the empty jug.
Use the empty bucket on the tap.
Use the full bucket on the 2/3rds full jug.
Use the 4/5ths full bucket on the chest with a scale on it.
Use the empty vase on the tap.
Use the vase lid on the filled vase
Use the filled, sealed vase on the frozen table.
Use the frozen key on the cooking range.
Open and go down the trapdoor.
Talk to Brundt in Rellekka's longhall to finish the quest.
Wait for Koschei the Deathless to spawn. If you brought a dramen branch you should now fletch it and equip the staff.
Climb up a rope/ladder to restart the puzzle.
Take the lid off the vase and fill the vase.
Empty jug and bucket to restart.
Please open the quest's Quest Journal to sync your state.
Pick a potato, cabbage and onion from the field in south east Rellekka.
Use the frozen vase on the cooking range.
